messages:
nina: Quick sync on daypart pacing for the webinar promo. We want to keep CPA steady but push registration volume during high-attention windows (weekday mornings + evenings). Proposal: allocate 60% budget to peak dayparts, 30% to shoulder, 10% to off-hour testing. Thoughts?

leo: Love the idea. Question: do we have historical hour-of-day CVR for the webinar audience segment? If mornings convert better we can shift more than 60%.

maya: I pulled last 3 months hour-level from GA: peak CVR 8-10AM (2.9%), 6-9PM (2.4%), midday (11AM-2PM) low at 1.1%. Suggest we weight 70/20/10 for those specific windows.

frank: On platform side, set pacing rules as daily spend caps + hourly rate limits so we don't burn through our promo budget too early. Also recommend a hard kill switch if CPA > 3x target for 2 consecutive hours.

nina: Good. Also we need retargeting routing: 1) 7d site visitors -> SDR queue if viewed pricing + demo page; 2) 1d registrants -> exclude from ads; 3) 14d engaged but not registered -> nurture flow. Can we wire that to the CRM webhook?

ads-bot: Draft routing payload prepared:```json
{"route":"sdr","conditions":[{"page_view":"/pricing"},{"session_duration_min":3}],"priority":1}
```
Will expose endpoint at https://hooks.redwood.ai/marketing/lead-route-2026. Confirm to push.

leo: Confirmed. For SDR routing add location filter (US/CA only) and lead_score >= 35. Otherwise send to nurture list.

maya: Creative plan: run 3 microtests across dayparts: (A) Speaker highlight + CTA, (B) Value prop bullets + CTA, (C) Social proof snippet. Rotate by daypart window and measure incremental registration lift controlled against baseline. Keep creatives under 5 variations to keep statistical power.

frank: For measurement: we need a holdout (10%) and two test cells (40/40). Assign by cookie/anonymous id. Tag creatives with test ids. Also ensure tracking params UTM_medium=paid_webinar and utm_content=testA/B/C.

ads-bot: Pacing matrix applied to campaign 'webinar_q2_push':```yaml
campaign: webinar_q2_push
budget_daily: 2000
daypart_weights: {"08:00-10:00":0.35,"18:00-20:00":0.25,"11:00-14:00":0.2,"off":0.2}
kill_rule: {"threshold_multiplier":3,"window_hours":2}
```
Deployed to staging at 1723456880.

nina: Nice. One more ask: include dynamic creative fallback for low CTR: if CTR < 0.35% for a daypart, swap to social-proof creative and throttle bids -15% for that slot.

leo: Added. Also set cost-cap bidding for search at target CPA + 10% during peak windows to capture extra volume without unlimited spend.

maya: I'll upload creatives to /ads/2026/webinar_daypart_test and label like: webinar_speaker_v1_1723456789, webinar_bullets_v1_1723456789, webinar_social_v1_1723456789.

frank: Reminder: exclude internal IP ranges and past registrants from ALL audiences. Add server-side dedupe check on webhook to avoid duplicate SDR pushes.

nina: Thanks all — pushing to prod on Tuesday 09:00 PT. Please monitor burn and conversions first 6 hours and keep channel updated. We'll reconvene for 48h post-mortem to review lift and any pacing adjustments. :rocket:
